atoms.text: The United Kingdom is an island nation found in northern Europe. It is made up of four countries: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. With around 55.9 million people, England is the largest of the four countries. The UK government sits in the Houses of Parliament which can be found in England’s capital, London. From London, you can reach Scotland’s capital Edinburgh in around 5 hours by train. With a population of around 5.5 million, Scotland is the UK’s second-largest country. Wales’ capital Cardiff is a lot closer to London, with the train journey lasting just under two hours. There are around 3.1 million people living in Wales. The smallest of the four countries, Northern Ireland, is home to around 1.8 million people. Northern Ireland can be reached by air and by sea, and you can fly to the capital Belfast from London in around 1.5 hours.

atoms.text:
Ancient Greece was a civilisation which existed many years ago. A lot of Roman culture was influenced by the Greeks, who came before them. Modern western culture is also influenced by ancient Greece.

Ancient Greece is often divided up into three time periods. The Archaic Period, which came first, is when the Olympic Games started. The Iliad and the Odyssey are two famous epic Greek poems which were also written at this time.

The Classical Period came next, and lasted around 200 years. One of the most important parts of ancient Greece was the rule of democracy, which has had a huge influence on modern society. There are also some very famous philosophers who lived in this time.

The final period followed, starting with the death of Alexander the Great, and ending with the downfall of Greece. This was called the Hellenistic Period.
